findings.claim: The retire law's terminality was enforced only at read seams: approve, red-check, pin-exempt, and pin-retire appended events after a retired event with exit 0 — the tool itself wrote the exact shape its fence then refused as a 'hand-edited' hand-forgery, falsifying the shipped comment and TASK-LIFECYCLE.md claim that the command law refuses appends after retirement (lanes 2f1, 4f1, 5f3, 6f1, 7f3, 8f2).
findings.proof: Live repro (sandbox, committed tools): new → planned → retire --because x → each of the four commands exits 0 appending chain-stamped events after the retired event; recordRefusal on the result returns 'an event follows the retired event... hand-edited record'. No authorization escapes (retired refuses everything either way) but the tamper narrative is false for machine-written records and two of the four are remedies the machine itself prints.

findings.claim: The wave manufactured its own reader-existence staleness: the new case helpers runRetirementSeamCases/runRetirementShapeCases sat outside the sweep's selfTest* corpus cut, their record("runtime-code") fixture classified AMBIGUOUS and suppressed the member's verdict, the LIVE accepted RISK_CLASSES.runtime-code row went stale, and the wave pruned it — deleting the documented NO_CONSUMER known-limit for the DEFAULT risk class while the gate stayed green (lanes 3f1, 5f1, 6f2, 7f1, 8f1).
findings.proof: Demonstrated on both trees: parent gate prints 'NO_CONSUMER RISK_CLASSES.runtime-code — 1 producer(s)'; HEAD prints no finding plus 'SUPPRESSED RISK_CLASSES — 1 unclassified use(s)'; a mutation probe adding a real consumer fails LOUDLY at the parent but silently passes at HEAD; renaming the helpers into the selfTest* cut plus restoring the row returns the finding with the gate green.
findings.dedupKey: the wave manufactured its own reader-existence staleness: the new case helpers runretirementseamcases/runretirementshapecases sat outside the sweep's selftest* corpus cut, their record("runtime-code") fixture classified ambiguous and suppressed the member's verdict, the live accepted risk_classes.runtime-code row went stale, and the wave pruned it — deleting the documented no_consumer known-limit for the default risk class while the gate stayed green (lanes 3f1, 5f1, 6f2, 7f1, 8f1).

findings.claim: The retirement reason — the law's namesake field, demanded by the CLI refusal and promised by three remedy strings — was written to the record and read by nothing: no tool ever printed it, unlike pin-retire and wont-fix justifications which handoff surfaces (lane 3f2).
